body: U+0023# 2026-10-03: sweep shipped, device check run, cleanup doneU+000AU+000AU+002A*Before this thread existed.** The owner asked for a Meadow quality and performance sweep on macOS and Android:U+000AU+002D a sharp background beside the crisp flowers;U+000AU+002D a Settings toggle for pausing on focus loss;U+000AU+002D insects that ride a swaying flower;U+000AU+002D an architecture review.U+000AU+000AIt was specced with interphase as `docs/specs/meadow-quality-performance.md`, 7 Steps and 20 criteria, binding answers in its decisions file. It was dispatched with mitosis 0.2.0 in three waves (run template `~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-sweep/`):U+000AU+002D #258, quality: screen-matched bake, quick scene then a 300 ms sharpen, shared scene cache;U+000AU+002D #259, performance: grouped glass blurs, night overlay shader, layer-free water marks, shell bench;U+000AU+002D #260, behaviour: insect sway, and a background-pause toggle placed in a Performance section of the Journal tab by owner decision, because five tabs overflow phones.U+000AU+000AThe pause Lane was finished by hand. The owner merged all three; main is at a13cd6e4.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Device check.** Spec section 15 holds the full table. Headlines:U+000AU+002D **Noon regression on both platforms.** The Note 10+ runs noon at 35 to 36 fps against 47 before. In the lab Mac VM, noon runs 7 to 8.5 fps against 62. Probes pin it on `_drawMark` in `meadow_water_marks.dart`: one Impeller offscreen pass per mark. With the marks off, both run at 60 fps.U+000AU+002D **Midnight passes.** 61.6 fps on the phone.U+000AU+002D **Wave 1 adds no per-frame cost.** It matches pre-sweep exactly.U+000AU+002D **Sharpening hitch.** The bake and crossfade take 1.2 to 1.4 s, with 29 to 38 frames over 33 ms and the longest 136 to 183 ms, from the raster thread congesting behind bakes. Scale 0.85 and 0.75 do not fix it, nor noon.U+000AU+002D **Glass.** Header and bottom bar are unchanged; the Today page is pixel-identical. The dock differs by 1 to 2/255 on average, invisible side by side.U+000AU+002D **Water and night.** Unchanged, with a mean difference of 0.002 to 0.010/255.U+000AU+002D **Heat and memory.** Noon over 600 s rose +5.1 C at 35 fps, against +6.6 C before at 46 fps. Keep-moving reached 45.2 C. PSS is up 30 MB. Scene images are 271 MB, against 48 MB before. The GPU caps silently after about 50 minutes of load.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Prepared for the owner.**U+000AU+002D Seeded phone apps `field_notes_before`, `_s100`, `_s085` and `_s075` are installed on the Note 10+ with keep-moving on.U+000AU+002D Mac apps for the same comparison are in the kit, with `seed_mac.zsh`, which the owner runs; it copies them to `~/Applications/Meadow check`.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Cleanup.**U+000AU+002D Moved to `~/.Trash/field-notes-cleanup-2026-10-03/`: 35 old mitosis run directories, about 30 old worktrees (`.fireplace-worktrees`, `.fireplace-worktrees-poster-first`, `testkit/work/manual`) and the three sweep wave worktrees.U+000AU+002D Deleted 186 local branches whose PRs merged or that were contained in a merged PR head.U+000AU+002D Kept: `chore/package-upgrade`, superseded on main but never opened as a PR, and 26 old `msp/*/task-*` branches not contained in any merged head.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Spec fixes.**U+000AU+002D Criterion 10.12 and the Expected, Assumptions and Reuse sections now describe the Journal-tab Performance section.U+000AU+002D The old `docs/specs/meadow.md` 16.19 and 16.22 now report scene-ready time on older devices rather than bounding it.
